title: Data Engineering, Analytics & Data Platforms
summary: Understand how operational data becomes trustworthy analytical and streaming data products across batch, CDC, warehouses, lakes and governed pipelines.

modules.title: OLTP vs OLAP & analytical architecture
modules.summary: Separate transactional serving from analytical scans/aggregations and understand why workloads diverge.
modules.why: Running analytics directly on operational stores can destroy production performance and constrains history/modeling.

units.title: OLTP vs OLAP workload shapes
units.summary: Compare point transactions with scans, aggregations and historical analysis.
units.challenge: Classify product queries and move analytical ones off the OLTP critical path.

units.title: Warehouse, lake & lakehouse concepts
units.summary: Understand structured analytical stores and object-storage-based data architectures.
units.challenge: Choose warehouse/lake/lakehouse patterns for BI, raw events and ML/RAG datasets.

units.title: Serving analytical results back to products
units.summary: Precompute/materialize heavy analytical results for product latency needs.
units.challenge: Serve tenant usage dashboards without issuing large warehouse queries per page load.
units.evidence: Analytical serving path with freshness/latency contract.

modules.title: ETL/ELT & batch data pipelines
modules.summary: Move and transform data reproducibly with explicit dependencies, retries and backfills.
modules.why: Data pipelines are production software with state, schemas and failure recovery—not one-off scripts.

units.title: ETL vs ELT & transformation placement
units.summary: Choose where raw data is transformed based on governance, cost and warehouse capabilities.
units.challenge: Design a pipeline from app DB/events to curated tenant-usage tables.

units.title: Batch partitioning, retries & idempotency
units.summary: Process large datasets in restartable chunks.
units.challenge: Backfill one year of data in partitions with safe restart after failure.
units.evidence: Job state/checkpoint model and retry tests.

units.title: Historical backfills & reproducibility
units.summary: Recompute old data safely when logic/schema changes.
units.challenge: Change revenue/usage logic and reprocess history without corrupting current dashboards.

modules.title: CDC & operational-to-analytical replication
modules.summary: Capture operational change streams without heavy polling or unsafe application dual writes.
modules.why: CDC can decouple analytics/search pipelines from request paths while preserving change history/order constraints.

units.title: Log-based CDC & snapshots
units.summary: Capture database changes from WAL/binlog with initial snapshot and ongoing offsets.
units.challenge: Design bootstrap from full snapshot into ongoing change stream.

units.title: CDC schema changes, deletes & compaction
units.summary: Handle DDL evolution and deletion semantics across downstream systems.
units.challenge: Evolve a source table while analytics/search consumers remain live.

units.title: CDC loss detection & reconciliation
units.summary: Prove downstream state matches source despite connector/outage issues.
units.challenge: Simulate missed changes and repair downstream store from source/log.
units.evidence: Reconciliation job and discrepancy handling policy.

modules.title: Dimensional & analytical data modeling
modules.summary: Model metrics and business dimensions for stable analytical use.
modules.why: Analytical schemas optimize comprehension and aggregation rather than transactional normalization.

units.title: Facts, dimensions & grain
units.summary: Define what one row means before aggregating metrics.
units.challenge: Model product activity/usage analytics with explicit grain.
units.evidence: Star-schema diagram and sample metric queries.

units.title: Slowly changing dimensions & history
units.summary: Preserve historical context when descriptive attributes change.
units.challenge: Report historical usage under the tenant plan/name that was valid at event time.

units.title: Metric definitions & semantic consistency
units.summary: Keep business metrics from drifting across dashboards/teams.
units.challenge: Define active-user and notification-delivery metrics so two dashboards cannot disagree silently.

modules.title: Streaming analytics & event-time pipelines
modules.summary: Use streaming systems for continuously updated analytical state while handling late/out-of-order data.
modules.why: Real-time analytics adds time semantics, state recovery and replay complexity beyond batch jobs.

units.title: Batch vs streaming & bounded/unbounded data
units.summary: Choose latency model and processing semantics from product needs.
units.challenge: Choose batch/streaming/hybrid for billing, live dashboard and search indexing.

units.title: Stateful streaming aggregates & materialized views
units.summary: Maintain continuously updated queryable state from events.
units.challenge: Maintain live project-activity counters with replayable state.

units.title: Late data, corrections & finality
units.summary: Define when windows/results are provisional vs final.
units.challenge: Handle mobile events arriving hours late without double-counting daily metrics.
units.evidence: Correction semantics and example output timeline.

modules.title: Data workflow orchestration & dependencies
modules.summary: Coordinate multi-step pipelines with schedules, sensors, retries and observable ownership.
modules.why: As data pipelines grow, dependency/control metadata becomes a production platform of its own.

units.title: DAGs, dependencies & data intervals
units.summary: Represent pipeline ordering and data partitions explicitly.
units.challenge: Model daily ingestion→transform→quality→publish dependencies.

units.title: Idempotent pipeline tasks & retries
units.summary: Make reruns safe after partial completion.
units.challenge: Rerun a failed daily partition without duplicating rows/results.
units.evidence: Task implementation and repeated-run equality test.

units.title: Data SLAs/SLOs, ownership & failure response
units.summary: Operate data pipelines with freshness/completeness objectives and clear owners.
units.challenge: Define SLOs/runbook for executive usage dashboard pipeline.

modules.title: Data quality, contracts & testing
modules.summary: Detect bad, missing, duplicated and semantically invalid data before it becomes decision input.
modules.why: Pipeline uptime is meaningless when values are silently wrong.

units.title: Completeness, validity, uniqueness & consistency
units.summary: Define measurable dimensions of trustworthy data.
units.challenge: Create quality checks for user/project activity datasets.
units.evidence: Quality specification and intentionally failing examples.

units.title: Data contracts & schema expectations
units.summary: Make producer responsibilities explicit for downstream consumers.
units.challenge: Write a contract for analytics event stream shared by five teams.

units.title: Data regression & reconciliation tests
units.summary: Catch transformation changes that alter important outputs unexpectedly.
units.challenge: Change transformation logic and compare old/new outputs before cutover.

modules.title: Metadata, lineage & data governance
modules.summary: Know where data came from, who owns it, how it may be used and what depends on it.
modules.why: Large data platforms fail socially and operationally when provenance/ownership are invisible.

units.title: Technical lineage & impact analysis
units.summary: Trace source fields through transformations to dashboards/products.
units.challenge: Trace one sensitive field from OLTP DB through CDC/warehouse/dashboard.

units.title: Data catalog, ownership & discovery
units.summary: Make datasets/metrics discoverable with clear stewardship.
units.challenge: Define minimum metadata for a self-service data catalog.
units.evidence: Dataset metadata schema and ownership rules.

units.title: Governance, access & retention
units.summary: Control sensitive analytical data across broad user/tool access.
units.challenge: Design analyst access to tenant data with masked PII and deletion/retention controls.
